description: Test that containers have /run pre-mounted before systemd is started
name: dist-config-systemd-rundir

almalinux-10.script:
machine.wait_for_osctl_pool("tank")
machine.wait_until_online

testct = get_container_id

machine.succeeds(
  "osctl ct new --distribution almalinux --version 10 #{testct}",
)



run_script_path = "/tmp/#{testct}-test-script.sh"

machine.push_file("/nix/store/ak520bf6g4pmpbp6g49xj13w3p83j7y8-dist-config-systemd-rundir-script.sh", run_script_path)
machine.succeeds("osctl ct runscript -r #{testct} #{run_script_path}")
machine.all_succeed(
  "osctl ct del -f --prune #{testct}",
  "osctl repository images prune"
)

nixos-stable.script:
machine.wait_for_osctl_pool("tank")
machine.wait_until_online

testct = get_container_id

machine.succeeds(
  "osctl ct new --distribution nixos --version stable #{testct}",
)

# NixOS needs to be first activated in order for /bin/sh to exist.
machine.succeeds("osctl ct unset start-menu #{testct}")
machine.succeeds("osctl ct start #{testct}")
machine.wait_until_succeeds("osctl ct exec #{testct} systemctl status")
machine.succeeds("osctl ct stop #{testct}")


run_script_path = "/tmp/#{testct}-test-script.sh"

machine.push_file("/nix/store/ak520bf6g4pmpbp6g49xj13w3p83j7y8-dist-config-systemd-rundir-script.sh", run_script_path)
